Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Garrett Rustic Acacia-Wood Coffee Table with Iron Legs, 52"W, Gray and Raw Metal
Colors: Grey/Raw Metal
Materials: Metal
Constructed of acacia, this coffee table touts a beautiful rustic style with visual knots and cracks covered with a sheer gray finish. Each unique piece has a live-edge top that sits on an open metalwork base. This table complements rustic, farmhouse, and contemporary decor with ease. 52"W x 26"D x 14"H Acacia and iron This rustic coffee table offers a natural beauty with a live-edge top that features knots and cracks, making each piece unique. A natural clear finish allows the beauty of the wood to shine through while protecting the surface. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
